audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff says FAV while diffRating is 8/10 and both difficulty lines say 'Hard matchup', against a 50% win rate over 12 games. Three different verdicts in one file.
audit.why: 50% is even. FAV, 8/10 and 'Hard matchup' cannot all be right. I could not fix it inside the length band - 'FAV' is 3 characters and 'EVEN' is 4, and '8/10' is 4 while '6.5/10' is 6 - so both are outside the +/-10% rule. Raised as a question instead of guessing which one the user wants.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; 'Riposte down' was the entire timing model.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s - by far the longest cooldown in the lane and the reason a baited Riposte is worth more than any trade. Lunge is 13s at rank 1 and only 400 range; Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[9].t and loading now carry 24s, 13s and 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says in four separate places that Riposte STUNS you when it parries Null Sphere - 'she Ripostes your Null Sphere (stunning you and blocking its shield)', 'Riposte your Null Sphere with W to stun you'. It does not. Riot: Riposte 'slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability'. Null Sphere is damage plus a shield, not an immobilizing effect, so parrying it can only slow you. Separately, content.early tells you to hold Q 'to stun a cast' - Null Sphere interrupts channels, it does not stun.
audit.why: The difference decides whether you can still Riftwalk out of a parried trade. Believing you get stunned means never casting Q near her; knowing it is only a slow means you can still leave.
audit.corrected: Corrected in content.spikes[1].text, content.early, content.mid, content.whys[4], content.wants.foe[1], full.dosFull[0].d and full.report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Lunge applies on-hit effects.
audit.why: Riot: 'Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.' Her item damage therefore rides a 13-second dash, which is why armour alone reads her trades wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain' - wrong pronoun, no source.
audit.why: Duelist's Dance restores health on every Vital hit and Grand Challenge heals Fiora AND her nearby allies, so Grievous Wounds is the difference between chunking her and chunking nothing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Fiora 'he'/'his' throughout and described her as a juggernaut.
audit.why: Fiora is female and is a duelist-assassin.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are hers and you know it — your only ability is Null Sphere, a single short-range orb she Q-dashes around, and then she's on you with vitals while you have no escape and almost no mana to fight back. Don't throw Q as poke; hold it for the shield (and to stun a cast) when she commits, and last-hit at max range. Her passive vitals deal percent-max-HP TRUE damage, so Void Stone's 15% magic reduction does nothing here — every vital she lands genuinely hurts. Concede CS, hug tower, and just survive to your W.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 you claw back toward even: maxed Null Sphere plus Nether Blade's huge mana restore (quintupled on her) finally lets you farm without going OOM and ride out her dives. But level 6 is a trap — a fresh Riftwalk is short-range and stackless, so if you blink in she Ripostes your Null Sphere (stun + no shield) and her R-plus-vitals out-duels you before your recasts ramp. Don't fight her at 6 on a single Riftwalk. Use it purely to escape her Q-dash gap-close and reset distance, then wait for your stall item.

notes: FABRICATED EFFECT: four fields said Riposte STUNS when it parries Null Sphere. Riot's text is explicit that it stuns only if it blocked an immobilizing effect and otherwise slows - and nothing in Kassadin's kit immobilizes, so against him Riposte can never stun. That changes the play: a parried Kassadin can still Riftwalk out. Also removed 'hold Q to stun a cast' - Null Sphere interrupts channels, it does not stun. LEFT ALONE and logged in unverified: the pre-existing 'Vitals deal percent-max-HP TRUE damage' claim (the kit's trueDamage flag sits on Grand Challenge, and Riot's Duelist's Dance text names no damage type), and the 'Nether Blade mana restore quintupled on champions' claim, which appears nowhere in Riot's text.
